summary: Name closely resembles vue-demi; placeholder content only
details: Package name closely resembles the popular 'vue-demi' package. The shipped contents are a single console.log statement ("Hello This Package is claimed for Responsible Disclosure") with no lifecycle scripts, no network I/O, no credential access, and no executable payload. The README presents the package as a placeholder claimed by a researcher. Name similarity to a widely-used package creates installer confusion risk, but no installer-side harm is present in this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
